limits: Expected core is a schema projection; predictions use the full frozen response schema.
Invalid/missing human expected annotations never become model errors or fabricated answers.
PILOT and SYNTHETIC cases excluded from all formal metric denominators; no dataset-size acceptance claim.
query_binding must be frozen by the evaluation owner from trusted request context; the scorer never derives it from the prediction.
Request conditions must already use canonical frozen labels; alias normalization is not performed by the scorer.
Semantic fields score PARSED expected cases only; original literal fields need an explicit validated llm_output sidecar.
Time uses uncut source microseconds and an explicitly pinned mapping, so clipping cannot hide a wrong time.
No parser, provider, question, answer or acceptance threshold is generated.
Script comparison is evaluation-only; no identity or physical-validity claim.
Agent/fallback flags are reported, not independently validated by this metric.
Positive windows compare one executed action plus camera/entry time; NO_SWITCH requires COMPLETE status and a decision reaching its window end.
Source-specific event ratios require observed executed actions; absent or mixed sources are OTHER. Fallback-only/non-fallback ratios exclude events without executed actions.
